configuration.parallel_evaluation_memory_note: Evaluation worker peaks exclude the waiting training ranks' resident model, optimizer and DDP state; total physical GPU usage includes both.
configuration.scope: Complete-epoch development, fixed seed17; no formal admission/final-user outcomes

evaluation.retrieval_scope: Free beam search over the configured 1000000-item catalog; not exhaustive top-k.
evaluation.request_selection: all positive requests in the complete three-day window; traffic-weighted mean, not equal1024/day
evaluation.random_definition: Uniform video permutation of the same allowed catalog or sampled pool; OOV positives remain in denominators.
evaluation.evaluation_panel_scope: Independent complete-window DEVELOPMENT sensitivity evaluation; retained alongside, and never replacing, the original3072-request panel results and failures.

sampled_request_panel.selection: Supplied fixed subset of the full panel

parallel_evaluation.sharding: Strided full-panel positions; sampled diagnostics use each shard's intersection.
parallel_evaluation.wall_time_scope: Worker dispatch through completion, including process/data/model startup; excludes coordinator merge.
parallel_evaluation.cost_note: Request sharding reduces elapsed time; this is not a claim of reduced GPU-seconds.
parallel_evaluation.peak_memory_scope: Top-level peaks are the maximum per GPU, not the sum across GPUs.
